children: IOI Corp.'s solar project JV looks positive as it allows the planter to generate higher returns from its land while securing a new source of long-term recurring income, CIMB Securities analyst Ivy Ng Lee Fang says in a note. IOI is taking a 25% stake in a 2 billion ringgit solar project in Malaysia's Negeri Sembilan state, involving an estimated 100 million ringgit equity investment, with commercial operations targeted for 2028. IOI will also lease about 1,300 acres of plantation land to the project, generating annual rental income estimated at 9.5 million ringgit. Ng estimates the venture and land rentals could contribute 22 million ringgit-24.5 million ringgit in annual net profit from 2029. CIMB maintains a buy rating on IOI and keeps its target price at 5.03 ringgit. Shares are 0.9% higher at 4.48 ringgit.(yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
